name: camera-mosaic-platform
description: Self-hosted IP camera mosaic streaming platform (FFmpeg + MediaMTX + RTSP for Roku)

scripts.build:backend: npm run build:shared && npm -w backend run build
scripts.build:frontend: npm run build:shared && npm -w frontend run build
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm -w backend run build && npm -w frontend run build
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,magenta "npm -w backend run dev" "npm -w frontend run dev"
scripts.dev:backend: npm run build:shared && npm -w backend run dev
scripts.dev:frontend: npm run build:shared && npm -w frontend run dev
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm -w backend run test
scripts.test:backend: npm run build:shared && npm -w backend run test
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm -w backend run typecheck && npm -w frontend run typecheck
